title: Relationships Between Two Variables
preview: Use variables to represent two related quantities; write equations from tables and graphs; move flexibly between representations.
description: Indiana standards 6.RP.5 and 6.AF.3. Students set up dependent / independent variable relationships and translate among tables, graphs, equations, and verbal descriptions.

sections.label: 7-1 Relationships Between Two Variables
sections.description: Use variables to represent two related quantities; identify dependent and independent variables.

sections.label: 7-2 Write Equations from Tables
sections.description: Inspect a table of values, find the rule, and write an equation that fits.

sections.label: 7-3 Graphs of Relationships
sections.description: Plot data from a table and describe the resulting graph.

sections.label: 7-4 Multiple Representations
sections.description: Translate freely among equation, table, graph, and verbal description for the same relationship.
